listing.name: Magic Ball 2 / OpenMB2
listing.summary: Play Magic Ball 2 and Smash Frenzy 2 with widescreen and controller support.
listing.download_block_reason: All three v1.0.2 packages include an original Russian game font. Portcove Download requires permission covering the bundled original game data or a replacement package without that data.

steps.title: Prepare a writable copy of your original game folder
steps.instruction: Use your own Magic Ball 2 or Smash Frenzy 2 installation. Keep its original data together, including any .pak or .dat archives. The engine writes player files in the game-data folder.

steps.title: Start the Windows engine
steps.instruction: If you have permission to use the Windows x64 OpenMB2 package, put OpenMB2.exe and the OpenMB2 folder in your writable game folder. Run OpenMB2.exe. The upstream guide also gives --game and --overrides options for keeping the engine files separate.

warnings: OpenMB2 writes progress and settings in the selected game-data folder, even when the engine is in a separate folder.

references.title: Keep your progress when replacing the engine
references.instruction: Close both engines and back up the writable game-data folder. Keep score.dat, the s<pack>.sav progress files, other save slots and openmb2.ini. OpenMB2 reads the original params.txt and keeps its own settings in openmb2.ini.

references.title: Set up the ARM64 Linux handheld package
references.instruction: Use the matching MuOS or PortMaster layout in the upstream instructions. Copy your original game files into that port’s openmb2/gamedata folder and start OpenMB2 from the handheld launcher. Back up gamedata to retain your progress and settings.
